title: Othello
description: Othello for two people sharing one phone, in 3D. Lay it flat and take an end each — the board never turns, but each player's score and controls sit at their own edge facing them. Real moulded discs with ivory side walls stand on a recessed felt well under a straight-overhead camera, and every capture is a physical half-turn: discs lift, show their cream edge, and land on the other face, staggered outward from the disc you placed so a twelve-disc take ripples like a wave. Strict tournament rules — forced passes are spelled out, corners are celebrated, and the match's biggest winning margin goes to the global board.
